{{Quote|Armed Intruder on Transport Deck! Set blasters to stun and apprehend! Do not expose yourself to fire! Squads Four and Five to support&hellip;|Orders are given to Squad Four aboard the ''Regina Cayli''|<ref name="J1">{{JournalCite|1|Regina Cayli (adventure)}}</ref>}}
'''Squad Five''', assigned to the [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] ''[[Regina Cayli]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was a unit of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Regina Cayli" />

==Behind the scenes==
Squad Five was featured in the roleplaying adventure "[[Regina Cayli (adventure)|Regina Cayli]]," first published in [[1987]]'s [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Regina Cayli" /> In [[1994]], it was subsequently reprinted in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="J1" />

Due to the nature of the adventure, it is possible for the player to never encounter Squad Five as they are only called upon if the player, as [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], is discovered while infiltrating the ''Regina Cayli''.<ref name="Regina Cayli" />
